name: copilot-self-055a8d5
description: Questions about this project's own source code and docs at commit 055a8d5, written by the project author (who also designed the retrieval system). Ground-truth regions were read and chosen manually.
limitations: Not independent: the author wrote both the code under test and the questions, so results are optimistic and cannot show generalisation.
Small (34 questions); differences of a few questions are within noise and no significance test is made.
The tests/ and submission/ directories are excluded from the index, which removes many plausible distractors.
Ground-truth regions are function-sized; larger chunks overlap them more easily (chunk-size confound).
Several questions use words that also appear in identifiers or docs, so lexical overlap helps the embedding model.
